pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: How Fernwood grows, matches and ships houseplants — hardy over fussy, honest about light and water, and a plain-English care card in every box.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Fernwood started on a windowsill and a stubborn refusal to accept that some people just “can’t keep plants alive.” Nobody is born with a green thumb — they just learn which plant suits which spot, and how little a healthy plant actually needs. We built the nursery to hand that head start to everyone else.

We grow our plants on rather than drop-shipping them, so what leaves us is acclimatised, pest-checked and genuinely ready for a home. We favour the hardy and forgiving over the fussy and rare, and we tell you the truth about the light and water a plant wants — even when the honest answer is “this one isn’t for your dim hallway.”
No jargon, no shaming, no plant older or sadder than it should be. Just healthy plants, matched to your space, with the plain guidance to keep them growing.
